Introducing our advanced OT Cyber Security Simulation Platform, a comprehensive system designed to provide a realistic and 
secure training and testing environment for operational technology systems.
SECURITY MANAGEMENT & SERVICES
Objective:  
Centralized Security Platform for monitoring, management & response
Key Reasons why this is needed:
• Utilize resources efficiently
• One-stop platform for visibility and response
• Real-time alerts and notifications
Management Platforms:
• Security Information & Event Monitoring (SIEM)
• Security Orchestration, Automation & Response (SOAR)
Management Services:
• Security Operations Center (SOC)
• Incident Response
ECQ offers a diverse range of standard 
sizes from which customers can select.
Mini Size Small Size Medium Size Large Size
Optional Attack Simulation
Clients can opt for additional attack 
simulations or other security products to rigorously test their system’s defenses and incident responses.
Authentic PLC Integration
At the heart of our simulation lies the integration of real programmable logic controllers (PLCs), paving the way for practical training and testing scenarios which closely mimic real-world operations.Security Replication
Our platform can optionally replicate your existing security infrastructure, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, security information and event management systems, and endpoint protection. This enables thorough security system testing and enhancement.Connectivity with Level 0 Devices
The simulation system links to Level 0 devices, including sensors, meters, and pumps, all interacting with a miniature replica of your plant.  This unique feature provides an immersive and highly authentic learning experience.• Realistic Configuration Transfer
• Network Traffic Simulation
• Tailor-Made For Your Needs
Virtualized Workstation Experience
Our platform offers the virtualization of crucial workstations such as the Human Machine Interface (HMI), engineering stations, historians, and databases, allowing for in-depth system understanding and exploration.
Real-World Process Simulation
Our platform perfectly models the processes of your actual operational environments, from water plants to power generation and distribution facilities, providing a comprehensive and realistic training ground.Key Features & ComponentsCustom Size Highlight

D.R.A.M.A. [Secure Code Review]
Secure Code Review helps identify vulnerabilities in source code of the application during the development phase and 
allows organizations to fix and address those identified issues before deploying to the real world. ECQ’s DRAMA code review 
approach offers both static and dynamic code analysis together with exploitation or Proof-of-Concept where possible to provide better severity rating for the vulnerable code block.
DRAMA code review approach contains five different phases: Define, Recon, Analyze, Manual Review, and Advise.
A.I.D.I.C.S. [OT & ICS components]
Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) are components that support industrial processes found in 
many critical infrastructures such as energy, oil and gas, chemical, and water.
Based on the extensive experiences in offensive security assessment and consultation of process networks, ECQ designs 
its own framework AIDICS that supports and helps customers in the OT/ICS sector to achieve better security to withstand external, internal, and accidental attacks.
